behaviours.name: Deadline & peer-review panic

behaviours.name: Tech-forward modern practitioner

behaviours.name: Burned by legacy CA software
behaviours.how: Tried Jamku or desktop ERP; found it cluttered, slow, or abandoned by staff after 2 months.

objections: My clients will never use an intake portal—they just dump bills on WhatsApp.
Why pay for software when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free?
Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year—why is Docketra more expensive?

If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder?
I am a solo CA with one trainee—why should I ever upgrade beyond the free tier?

pitch:
Docketra: The Sovereign Practice Operating System for Indian CA, CS, and Compliance Firms.
Primary-Admin Sovereign Security: Connect your firm's Google Drive via Primary-Admin OTP with certified restricted OAuth (drive.file scope)—Docketra cannot read existing firm folders; staff have zero ability to alter Drive connections; 100% of client records stay in your own Drive.
30-Second WhatsApp & Email Ingestion Bridge: Clients never log into a portal; clerks forward or drag-and-drop messy WhatsApp document dumps directly into structured dockets in 30 seconds.
The Zero-Training Trainee Kit & Maker-Checker: Turn rotating CA/CS article clerks into productive preparers on Day 1 with pre-loaded statutory blueprints (Companies Act AOC-4/MGT-7, SEBI SDD/LODR, GST, Tax Audit Form 3CD with 44 clauses, FEMA), producing an immutable sign-off audit trail for ICAI/ICSI peer reviews.
Transparent Packaging & Bonuses:
- Free Sandbox: ₹0 forever for up to 2 seats, 5 active clients, 15 dockets/mo.
- Pioneer 30 Annual Pass: ₹12,990/yr flat (~₹1,082/mo) or ₹1,499/mo for up to 5 seats, 50 clients, 100 dockets/mo, including free 24-hr concierge Excel client migration and zero setup fees.
- Pro Tier: ₹4,999/mo annual (or ₹5,999/mo monthly) for 15 seats, department queues, and priority support.
30-Day Sovereign Guarantee: 100% refund if it does not save you 10 hours a week—plus all client folders, organized dockets, and statutory blueprints remain permanently in your Google Drive even if you cancel.
